basin_classification.EXCITED_PLATEAU_ONLY: cyclic neutral component exists but is neither global nor local minimum under the examined scalar
basin_classification.GLOBAL_MINIMUM_NEUTRAL: cyclic neutral component has scalar value equal to exact E_min
basin_classification.LOCAL_MINIMUM_NEUTRAL: not global minimum, and no state in the cyclic neutral component has an elementary neighbor with lower scalar value
basin_classification.NO_NONBACKTRACKING_CYCLE: no simple neutral cycle of length >=3

cycle_semantics.reversible_two_step: reported but not used as the preferred robustness witness
cycle_semantics.scc_note: because declared adjacency is symmetric and equality neutrality is reversible, directed SCCs coincide with connected components of the corresponding neutral undirected graph
cycle_semantics.simple_nonbacktracking_cycle: simple undirected neutral cycle with at least 3 distinct states

definitions.R0: E_c(S)=sum_{i<j} sum_n c_n W_n(a_i,a_j)=c dot A_K(S)
definitions.S_K: ordered finite integer tuple (W_n)_n in frozen window K
definitions.W_n: exact number of declared-adjacency walks with exactly n transition events

elementary_move.rule: exactly one tagged marker makes exactly one declared adjacency transition

move_classes.MULTIPAIR_EXACT_CANCELLATION: at least one affected pair spectrum changes but total DeltaA=0
move_classes.PAIRWISE_INVARIANT: every affected labeled pair spectrum is unchanged
move_classes.SCALAR_WEIGHT_CANCELLATION_ONLY: DeltaA!=0 but c dot DeltaA=0 for the examined c
